info.title: migrate-mongo
info.description: The migrate-mongo command line tool for Kevsoft.MigrateMongo: create, apply and roll back MongoDB migrations written in C#. Works with any .NET runtime (8+) and any supported MongoDB driver version because your migrations run in your own project.

options.name: --file
options.description: Path to the config file (default: migrate-mongo.yaml).

options.name: --env
options.description: Environment from the config file to use.

options.name: --json
options.description: Write machine-readable JSON lines instead of text. [default: False]

options.name: --no-build
options.description: Don't build the migrations project first. [default: False]

options.name: --runner
options.description: Run a pre-built runner (a .dll or a bundle executable) instead of building the project.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Create a config file and a migrations project.

options.name: --project
options.description: Where to create the migrations project. [default: Migrations]

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: Name of the migration, e.g. AddEmailIndexToUsers.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show the state of every migration.

options.name: --check
options.description: Exit with code 2 if there are pending migrations. [default: False]

commands.name: plan
commands.description: Show what 'up' would do. Exits with code 2 if there is pending work.

options.name: --to
options.description: Roll back every migration after this id (exclusive).

options.name: --count
options.description: Number of migrations to roll back (default 1).

options.name: --batch
options.description: Roll back the whole last batch. [default: False]

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Check applied migrations against the code (checksums, missing and out-of-order migrations).

commands.name: baseline
commands.description: Record migrations as applied without running them.

options.name: --to
options.description: Record every migration up to and including this id as applied.

options.name: --applied
options.description: Record the migration as applied (also accepts its current checksum). [default: False]

options.name: --unapplied
options.description: Remove the migration's state so it runs again. [default: False]

commands.name: unlock
commands.description: Remove an expired (or, with --force, any) migration lock.

options.name: --force
options.description: Remove the lock even if it hasn't expired. [default: False]
